HNR Global Private Limited is a premier software development and product innovation company headquartered in Visakhapatnam, with a strategic presence in Hyderabad. We transform bold ideas into scalable digital solutions that drive business growth and operational excellence.

About Us-

Who We Are Founded with a vision to bridge the gap between innovative technology and real-world business challenges, HNR Global Private Limited has emerged as a trusted partner for companies seeking cutting-edge software solutions and top-tier tech talent. With dual operations in Hyderabad and Visakhapatnam, we combine the technological ecosystem of India's IT capital with the emerging talent pool of the east coast to deliver exceptional value to our clients. Our Mission To empower businesses through innovative software development, strategic product engineering, and world-class recruitment solutions that accelerate digital transformation and sustainable growth. Our Vision To be the preferred technology partner for global enterprises, recognized for excellence in product development, operational efficiency, and talent acquisition. What We Do – Our Services-

Custom Software Development We build bespoke software solutions tailored to your unique business requirements.   1. Product Development & Engineering

  1. Mobile App Development
Native and cross-platform mobile applications that engage users and drive business results. We build: • iOS &amp; Native Android apps • Cross-platform apps (Flutter, React Native) • Enterprise mobile solutions • App modernization and maintenance
  1. IT Recruitment & Staffing Solutions
Finding the right talent is hard. We make it effortless. Our recruitment services: • Permanent Hiring: Full-time tech talent across all levels • Contract Staffing: Flexible resources for project-based needs • Executive Search: CTO, VP Engineering, Principal Architects • Campus Recruitment: Fresh talent from premier institutions • RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing): End-to-end hiring management Domains we recruit for: • Software Development (Full Stack, Backend, Frontend) • DevOps &amp; Cloud Engineering • Data Science &amp; AI/ML • QA &amp; Test Automation • Product Management • UI/UX Design
  1. Digital Transformation Consulting
Strategic guidance to navigate your digital journey with confidence. We help you: • Assess current technology landscape • Define digital roadmap aligned with business goals • Select right technologies and partners • Execute transformation with minimal disruption


Why Choose HNR Global?
